Author: Raj Beer Singh
Bench: Raj Beer Singh
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Kshitij Tiwari

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A., Naveen Singh
Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicants, learned counsel for the informant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the entire record.

2. The present bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicants in case crime No. 331/2023,
under Sections 354, 376(d) IPC & Section 5/6 of POCSO Act, police station Alinagar, District Chandauli with the prayer to enlarge the applicants on bail.
3. It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicants that the accused-applicants are innocent and they have not committed any offence.

The victim herself has lodged the first information report,
Bobby Deol @ Boda Bind And Another vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/146601624/
1 alleging that applicants have done 'cherchhar' with her.

entities.text: Bobby Deol @ Boda Bind And Another vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The first information report was lodged u/s 354 IPC and there were no allegations of rape in the first information report.

In her statements,
recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C., victim has developed her version and made false allegations of rape against the applicants.
In medical examination report, no injury has been shown on the body of victim.
In the first information report, the year of date of birth of the victim has been mentioned as 2005.
Ossification test of the victim has not been conducted.
4. It is further submitted that victim has already been examined before the trial court, wherein she did not support the prosecution version.
Learned counsel has referred the statement of victim/PW-1 and statement of PW-2, who is father of victim, and pointed out that they have denied the prosecution version and turned hostile.
Victim has denied the involvement of applicants.
It was submitted that the applicants are in judicial custody since 27.11.2023 and that there are a number of formal witnesses, who are yet to be examined before the trial court.
Lastly, it was submitted that in case applicants are enlarged on bail, the applicants will not misuse the liberty of bail.

5. Learned counsel for the informant has not opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that victim has already turned hostile.
6.
Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail.
However, it could not be disputed that during trial victim has not supported the prosecution version and turned hostile.

7. Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, period of custody and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the Court is of the view that a case for bail is made out.
Hence, the bail application is hereby allowed.

8. Let the applicants Bobby Deol @ Boda Bind and Mulayam involved in the aforesaid crime be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two local sureties each of the like amount to the satisfaction of court concerned subject to the following conditions:
i.
The applicants shall not tamper with the evidence during trial.
ii. The applicants shall not pressurize/intimidate the prosecution witnesses.
iii. The applicants shall appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
iv. The applicants shall not try to contact, threat or otherwise influence the complainant or any of the witness of the case.
9. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel the bail of applicants, in accordance with law.

Order Date :- 15.5.2024 Anand  Bobby Deol @ Boda Bind And Another vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/146601624/
